protocol.interpretation: same parent and input order; sampling hierarchy changes are part of the repair
protocol.performance_scope: final regressions overlap preparation and early updates; compare matching tail 200 updates rather than total alone

regression.historical_failure_cause: new test fixtures omitted semantic event family policy; constructor correctly rejected incompatible settings

limits: One fixed song and two sampled seeds plus one greedy stress chart are not a corpus quality evaluation.
Run lengths describe output; repetition can be musically intended.
No playtest or listening acceptance was performed.
Local head ablation is not a full music ablation or proof of causal musical control.
Control and new-stage losses differ in exposure to counterfactual history.
WebUI 7860 process refresh was rejected by automatic policy review; manually restart before using new policies.

timeline.scope:
CPU-only local transition-head probes; never train or rebuild audio caches.

Music-off changes only the encoded key field read by the new head. The original
decoder hidden state, physical history, condition, audio clock, and main model
output stay fixed. Run-off clears continuation_features only; actual event gaps
and clocks stay intact. Neither perturbation proves musical quality or measures
the causal contribution of the whole audio encoder.

V2 outputs are raw log-odds corrections, never keep probabilities. Actual keep
mass is aggregated from the final actor distributions. Local ablations hold
that actor's base odds fixed and alter only the residual head contribution:
logit(P_ablated) = logit(P_full) + gain*(raw_ablated-raw_full). V2 gain is 8;
V1 is the compatible absolute-logit path with gain 1. Unsupported groups remain
deterministic. Log-odds are read before float32 sigmoid rounding to 0 or 1.
